Dated phylogeny with branches and nodes colored by in-situ vs. colonization classification

plot_classified_phylo.Rd

Dated phylogeny with branches and nodes colored by in-situ vs. colonization classification

Usage

plot_classified_phylo(phy, events, PAM)

Arguments

phy

The phylogenetic tree associated with your data

events

The dataframe returned by map_insitu_events. If the user would like to input a custom dataframe, ensure that it has the following columns: node (internal node numbers associated with the given phylogenetic tree), island (the name of the island associated with the ancestral state for that node), and in_situ (logical - whether in situ speciation occurred at the given node).

PAM

The presence-absence matrix associated with your data as returned by the match_island_phylo function.
